methodology.hypothesis: monthly revenue acceleration can discover candidates early, while the latest financial statement known at the event date can confirm earnings quality or a quality regime change
methodology.anti_lookahead: financial rows are joined only when conservative_known_date <= monthly event effective_trading_date/conservative_availability_date
methodology.baseline: same-month listed-stock universe with complete return horizon
methodology.limitation: existing monthly-signal files currently provide D1/D3/D5/D10/D20; D40/D60 require extending the underlying return-enrichment dataset before those horizons can be tested without inventing data
